requirement.statement: .NET OM SHALL expose idiomatic typed public facades for explicit parent Keep/Set/Clear updates, constraint validation, traversal, and value-type inference while retaining compatibility wrappers for ambiguous legacy calls.

case.given: callers use the public C# facade
case.when: they clear a parent, validate, traverse, or infer a value type
case.then: the observable outcome SHALL match the Bun capability under D0=A.

requirement.statement: .NET OM SHALL validate behavior owners, scopes and interceptor phases before persistent metadata or callback registry effects, leaving no ghost registration on rejection.

case.given: invalid owner scope or phase input
case.then: it SHALL be rejected without metadata or callback side effects.
